pages.title: Gaining affinity
pages.text: Affinity starts at 0. Curios can roll 0–50 points, active while worn. The $(l:zuosha_botu)domain jackpot$() adds 100 for 33 seconds.

pages.title: Using affinity
pages.text: Affinity raises cursed energy capacity and regeneration, boosts technique and domain damage, and shortens burnout. Technique cost is multiplied by (1 − affinity/100).

pages.title: Excluded curios
pages.text: The common [curse_affinity] blacklist starts empty. Listed items skip automatic affinity rolls in loot, inventories and curio slots. Existing affinity remains, including when old data is migrated.

pages.title: Matching items
pages.text: @curios, curios and curios:* each match the whole namespace. example:gold_ring matches one item. A * matches any number of characters; ? matches one. Each side of the colon matches separately, as in *:*_ring or example:charm_?.
